name:
Sonic & All-Stars Racing
Transformed™
description:
Sonic and the All-Stars cast line up
on the starting grid once again to
battle for supremacy in the ultimate
race. Compete across land, water and
air in incredible transforming vehicles
that change from cars to boats to
planes mid-race. Master your driving
skills as you drift, barrel role and
boost to overtake your rivals, or use
your weapons tactically and unleash
your All-Star move to gain the winning
advantage.
disclaimer:
Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or “Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “sleep mode.”

In-game content available for purchase using stored account funds.
